name: Seamless Grid
description: Full-screen image grid that expands a tile into a full-bleed slider with title, paragraph and thumbnails, switched by a Grid/Slider toggle, with a counting preloader on load.
contents: Full-screen slider with title and paragraph overlay
behavior: Preloader counts to 100 then fades out
Active tile expands with GSAP Flip into a full-screen slide
Slides change with a parallax sideways transition via thumbnails, arrow keys or swipe
Toggle returns the slide to its grid tile
editableByProps: Colors, fonts, preloader duration, grid size, thumbnail size and toggle labels

needsCodeEdit.where: T constant inside the init function
CustomEase.create calls for mainEase and sideEase

fixed: Loads a font stylesheet link into document.head for the mono font
Listens for arrow keys and touch swipes on the document while mounted
Preloader, slider layers, thumbnails and toggle use fixed positioning over the viewport
Root is a full-screen section that clips its content
